title: 3.2inch Ceramic Mortar and Pestle Set, Pill Crusher, Spice Crusher, Ceramic Mixing Grinding Bowl Set, Include Brush and Spoon
description:
About this item
1. Made of good quality of porcelain. You can be firmly held in the hand.
2. Provides a simple way to crush and grind pills, spice,etc.
3. The mortar comes with a flat and unglazed bottom for stability.
4. Nice mortar with a pouring lip which also serves to hold the coordinating pestle in place.
5. You can get a brush and a pill spoon for additional requirements.
reviews_5s: Works great for crushing up meds for a child. Recommend if you need to crush meds for a child that can not swallow pills.Fantastic little mortar and pestle. And I do mean little. Tiny, yet mighty, this little "pill crusher" is exactly what I need to easily crush and powder my L. reuteri probiotic tablets for making homemade yogurt with. It's lightweight, easy to use, easy to clean, looks attractive, and is a good deal.I LOVE IT !!!!!! i can crush the pills into powder . love itWorks well. The brush is a great accessory. There are always grains that don't tip out and this way it is all swept in. Small size is easy to store.As pictured/ described.I purchased this to grind a pill for my cat. As the pill is very small. I put some plastic wrap in the bowl to insure I didn't lose any of the medication. Both worked. This little mortar and pestle set is great for food items and it's so cute!My sweet cat is on pills now and giving a cat a pill is extremely hard so I now grind it up mix it with a small amount of chicken Broth then suck it up in a syringe and squirt it in his little mouth.This is amazing for pills! My dog has epilepsy and she has to take a pill three times a day so I make her homemade dog treats and I have to grind each pill individually and mixed with the dog treat this was a time changer! I can make 2 weeks worth of treats and the amount of time it took me to make a couple days crushing the pills up with the flat of a blade. I've already dropped it several times and no damage. It's easy to get all the granules out. Would highly recommend!Bowl was cracked in half on first order, return was easy and replacement was quick. No hassles. Product is as described and has made it much easier to adminster pill to our kitty.I use this every day 2 times for my mother’s medicine and supplements! It is just the right size and very good quality I really like that they include a brush and spoon tool I use them every day!
reviews_1s:
Incomplete kit. Didn't receive all of the advertised items. Returned.Firstly, my mother needs her aspirin crushed up and put into a drink, as she can’t swallow pills.

This mortar and pestle is very porous. We lost about 1/2 of an aspirin pill in the first crush. If you look at the photo, you’ll see the residue.

They give you a little crummy metal “spoon” and a “brush” to get the medicine off of the sides. But there’s still a ton of aspirin left.

Way more trouble than it’s worth. I’m going to just dissolve her aspirin in orange juice. I give up.
